notes: HiTS is a cross-institutional research network (Laboratory of Systems Pharmacology + Center for Regulatory Science), not a department with its own PI-led labs. Its ~40-person faculty list is almost entirely PIs whose primary lab and appointment is elsewhere -- MGH, BWH, Tufts, Columbia, Stanford, BIDMC, Boston Children's, and several HMS departments already covered in this project (e.g. Peter Sorger and Galit Lahav are HMS Systems Biology faculty, recorded in harvard-hms-sysbio.json; Michael Baym and Jeffrey Moffitt already recorded in harvard-hms-microbiology.json). Not duplicating that list here. Recommend status 'done' -- confirmed this is a hub, not itself a source of new small labs.
